title: Arannde Ɗaɓɓude Yaafuya
intro: Njokken e jamaanu ko adii nde naange fuɗata, ko adii nde kala maayɗo ina yaha e leydi. Natal feewnaama e geɗe ɓurɗe lesɗude, rokkaama station dow maleykaaji, waɗtaa e nder jarne ceniinde e jeertinaango laaɓtungo. Kono e nder dumunna gooto, suɓngo waɗaama — suɓngo ngo ina ƴellitoo e nder daartol aadee fof. Hol ooɗoo limoore?
clues: Mi waddaama e mbaadi ndi nanndaani e gocfcfo — mi 6eydaama e 6uu6ol leydi, mi rokkaama ruuhu guurcfo e junngo Tagcfo.
Mi rokkaama ganndal luggiɗngal haa hay maleykaaji dow ɗii ina kaawaa ɗum.
Asamaan fof yamiraama yo sujjan yeeso am, kam6e fof 6e 6eydii ɗooftaade — so wonaa gooto, mo salii sabu mawnikinaare.
Mi wacfaama e nder jarne ceniicfo, nokku 6urcfo welde e 6amtaare haa abada — kono e haɗeede wootere tiiɗnde.
Mi yejjitii, mi 6uuccii, mi 6uuccii — mi nanii teddungal majjere am no feewi.
Mi ruttitiima e joomi am e konnguɗi ceeɓɗi e ɓernde, o jaɓii tuubuubu am, sabu ko kaŋko woni yaafoowo.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Leñol ngol yani e ɓuuɓol mawngol

arabic: فَتَلَقَّىٰٓ ءَادَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِۦ كَلِمَـٰتٍۢ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verse: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful. (2:37)
